title: Vallási türelem (Religious Tolerance)
grammar: Recap: kimondta, hogy ... and Verbs for Laws

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can say what the 1568 Diet of Torda declared about faith.
I can name the four religions that became received religions in Transylvania.
I can cite historic legal decrees using törvénybe iktat and kinyilvánít.
I can use the new words about religious freedom and the denominations.
